Question 4
?

Given that y0(x)=x is a particular solution of the Riccati differential equation

y′=−xy2+2x2y+1−x3

find the general solution of the equation.

a
y=x+22x2+C
b
y=x+2x2+C
c
y=x−2x2+C
d
y=x+1x2+C
e
y=x+2x2+x+C
